Brass Accents A06-P0241 Decorative Palladian Door Pull 3" Wide x 12" High

The term "Palladian" comes from Andrea Palladio, a Renaissance architect whose work inspired some of the greatest buildings in Europe and the United States, most notable in the buildings designed by Thomas Jefferson, including his own home, Monticello. The classic Palladian shape is a central including his own home, Monticello. The classic Palladian shape is a central semicircular arch flanked on each side by strong rectangular pillars.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance, hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of decorative hot-forged and cast brass door hardware.

Also Available Matching: Palladian Traditional Push Plate

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.
